description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel, an API model used for representing employee leave entitlements in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes properties for employee details and entitlement information, methods for constructing the model, and converting it to an array for serialization.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel
classes.description: A model representing employee leave entitlement details, including employee info and remaining leave days, used in API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementModel with employee data, leave entitlements, and optional entitlement override value.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model into an associative array suitable for serialization, calculating current entitlement based on leave types.
